blocks.text:
Convenience is key when it comes to your everyday device, and Galaxy Flip7 FE is a reliable, pocket-sized partner for all your daily needs.
Navigate the small stuff from the cover screen or flip Flip7 FE open for a big screen experience — all without compromise. The convenient FlexWindow on Galaxy Flip7 FE lets you handle quick tasks like checking the weather or skipping a song directly from your cover screen without opening your phone. And when a photo op happens on your family trip, easily go from folded to FlexMode and snap incredible pictures of the whole crew with the 50MP camera.
While it’s the perfect phone for those on the go, don’t let its small size fool you — Galaxy Flip7 FE packs tons of power¹ into a small, stylish frame. Handle all your to-dos with the long-lasting battery and powerful processor of Flip7 FE that’s designed to keep up with you throughout your day.With Galaxy Flip7 FE, enjoy convenience, performance and style in a perfectly pocketable phone that slips seamlessly into your day.

¹Based on average battery life under typical usage conditions. Average expected performance based on typical use. Actual battery life depends on factors such as network, features selected, frequency of calls, and voice, data, and other application usage patterns. Results may vary.

items.label: GET THE SHOT FROM ANY SPOT
items.value: FlexMode is your shortcut to capturing the moment. Just flip open Galaxy Z Flip7 FE, pick your angle and shoot completely hands free – no awkward grips or balancing acts required.

items.label: OPEN LESS. DO MORE
items.value: With Gemini Live and your favorite apps on FlexWindow, Galaxy Z Flip7 FE does more before you even open it.¹

items.label: 50MP CAMERA. 10/10 PICS
items.value: Take amazing photos you’ll flip for with Galaxy Z Flip7 FE. Capture stunning details in your photos and hands-free selfies that stand out with an impressive 50MP camera.

items.label: COMPACT AND PACKED WITH POWER
items.value: Galaxy Z Flip7 FE packs tons of big phone energy into a small, stylish frame. Smoothly handle content creation, daily tasks, video calls and more — the long-lasting battery of Z Flip7 FE is designed to keep up with you.

items.label: SMALL, BUT POWERS THROUGH IT ALL
items.value: With a long-lasting battery and a powerful processor, Galaxy Z Flip7 FE is the small phone that can power through it all.

items.label: HEALTH TRACKING COMES FULL CIRCLE
items.value: Take control of your health by marrying Galaxy Z Flip7 FE with Galaxy Ring. Designed for those on the go, Ring lets you comfortably keep tabs on your health with sleep tracking, Energy Score and Wellness Tips.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Always On Display, Built-In GPS, Fast Charging Support, Mobile Hotspot Capability, Wireless Charging
